source_text:
These solutions were added to a 384-
well source plate (80 µL per well). The Mosquito HTS liquid handling robot was used to dose
each of these solutions (200 nL each) into a 1536-well plate.

AddToPlateWells.name: AddToPlateWells
AddToPlateWells.description: Add liquid material into multiwell plate wells at the reported volume and distribution basis, using a specified liquid handler when reported. Plate well count denotes capacity, not the number of occupied wells or additions. The volume basis distinguishes an amount per well from an amount for each solution.
effects: Introduces liquid material into destination plate wells according to the specified volume and distribution basis.

heater.parameter_scope: Heating-plate setpoint maximum, not guaranteed liquid temperature; minimum depends on ambient/self-heating.
heater.note: Proposed analysis controller; source does not identify this model as the original equipment.

hardware.binding_scope: Source-reported vessels; unspecified automation remains a proposed analysis configuration. Edges are provisional.
hardware.inventory_scope: Sum of stated Add volumes, not peak vessel occupancy or inferred solvent volume.
